normalized.result: Yes, this feels right for a big collection. The first card had a really long title and description, and the app trimmed them with a little "…" so the card stayed the same tidy size as all the others — which made scrolling down through hundreds of them easy to scan, nothing jumping around. And the whole time the search box, the All bookmarks / Read later / Archive counts, and my tags stayed put on the side within easy reach, so even with 248 saved I never felt lost or like I'd have to hunt. As long as the full title, description, and notes are still there on the bookmark's own details view — which you've said they are — trimming them on the cards is exactly the right trade. This feels right.
